source_text: 1Hero! Girls only!

structure.raw_value: HnMaAgNo1.1Hero! Girls only!
structure.script_literal: "HnMaAgNo1.1Hero! Girls only!"

translation: 1Hero! Wstęp tylko dla dziewczyn!

source_text: Have fun, girls.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Have fun, girls.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Have fun, girls."

translation: Dobrej zabawy, dziewczyny.

source_text: 1Hero? What are you doing back?

structure.raw_value: ChShOp.1Hero? What are you doing back?
structure.script_literal: "ChShOp.1Hero? What are you doing back?"

translation: 1Hero? Co ty tu znowu robisz?

source_text: You better not flake on our pool party later.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.You better not flake on our pool party later.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.You better not flake on our pool party later."

translation: Lepiej nie wystaw nas później na imprezie przy basenie.

source_text: Coming back for seconds?

structure.raw_value: HnFlDe.Coming back for seconds?
structure.script_literal: "HnFlDe.Coming back for seconds?"

translation: Wróciłeś po dokładkę?

source_text: Sorry, Hannah. I can’t stay.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Sorry, Hannah. I can’t stay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Sorry, Hannah. I can’t stay."

translation: Wybacz, Hannah. Nie mogę zostać.

source_text: I hope you can fix the bathroom. I don’t want to have to go outside.

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.I hope you can fix the bathroom. I don’t want to have to go outside.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.I hope you can fix the bathroom. I don’t want to have to go outside."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że naprawisz łazienkę. Nie chcę załatwiać się na dworze.

source_text: The plumbing issues are fixed.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.The plumbing issues are fixed.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.The plumbing issues are fixed."

translation: Problemy z kanalizacją są już naprawione.

source_text: Oh, thank God. I was getting worried.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Oh, thank God. I was getting worried.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Oh, thank God. I was getting worried."

translation: Och, dzięki Bogu. Zaczynałam się martwić.

source_text: What are you doing outside? You’re going to catch a cold.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.What are you doing outside? You’re going to catch a cold.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.What are you doing outside? You’re going to catch a cold."

translation: Co robisz na dworze? Przeziębisz się.

source_text: Oh, uhh… I was just looking for that goat.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Oh, uhh… I was just looking for that goat.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Oh, uhh… I was just looking for that goat."

translation: Och, eee… Szukałem tego kozła.

source_text: I hope the little guy is okay.

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.I hope the little guy is okay.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.I hope the little guy is okay."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nic mu nie jest.

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: HeWoClNo1.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoClNo1.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: I don’t feel so good.

structure.raw_value: McHuCl.I don’t feel so good.
structure.script_literal: "McHuCl.I don’t feel so good."

translation: Nie czuję się najlepiej.

source_text: Is it your stomach?

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.Is it your stomach?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.Is it your stomach?"

translation: Boli cię brzuch?

source_text: I’m okay.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl!c.I’m okay.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl!c.I’m okay."

translation: Nic mi nie jest.

source_text: Come here. Sit down.

structure.raw_value: HeWoEx.Come here. Sit down.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoEx.Come here. Sit down."

translation: Chodź tutaj. Usiądź.

source_text: I hope we didn’t push things too far at the creek.

structure.raw_value: CaWoOp.I hope we didn’t push things too far at the creek.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoOp.I hope we didn’t push things too far at the creek."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nad strumieniem nie posunęliśmy się za daleko.

source_text: I don’t think that’s what Heather is worried about.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I don’t think that’s what Heather is worried about.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I don’t think that’s what Heather is worried about."

translation: Nie sądzę, żeby to martwiło Heather.

source_text: It has something to do with a magic rock.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It has something to do with a magic rock.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It has something to do with a magic rock."

translation: To ma coś wspólnego z magicznym kamieniem.

source_text: If you have any news on your case, I’d love to hear it.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.If you have any news on your case, I’d love to hear it.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.If you have any news on your case, I’d love to hear it."

translation: Jeśli masz jakieś wieści w sprawie, chętnie ich posłucham.

source_text: I can only share so much, but if I find anything new I’ll let you know.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I can only share so much, but if I find anything new I’ll let you know.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I can only share so much, but if I find anything new I’ll let you know."

translation: Nie mogę zdradzić zbyt wiele, ale dam ci znać, jeśli czegoś się dowiem.

source_text: Did you talk to Heather?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Did you talk to Heather?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Did you talk to Heather?"

translation: Rozmawiałaś z Heather?

source_text: All’s well.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.All’s well.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.All’s well."

translation: Wszystko w porządku.

source_text: She didn’t say anything?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.She didn’t say anything?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.She didn’t say anything?"

translation: Nic nie powiedziała?

source_text: Would she have something to tell me?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Would she have something to tell me?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Would she have something to tell me?"

translation: Miałaby mi coś do powiedzenia?

source_text: No… Just… You know… She’s been acting kinda funny.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.No… Just… You know… She’s been acting kinda funny.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.No… Just… You know… She’s been acting kinda funny."

translation: Nie… Po prostu… Wiesz… Dziwnie się ostatnio zachowuje.

source_text: Cause she’s worried about you. You know how much she cares about you.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Cause she’s worried about you. You know how much she cares about you.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Cause she’s worried about you. You know how much she cares about you."

translation: Bo się o ciebie martwi. Wiesz, jak bardzo jej na tobie zależy.

source_text: Are the girls settled into Hannah’s room?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Are the girls settled into Hannah’s room?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Are the girls settled into Hannah’s room?"

translation: Dziewczyny zadomowiły się w pokoju Hannah?

source_text: It’s a small bed, but they can manage.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s a small bed, but they can manage.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s a small bed, but they can manage."

translation: Łóżko jest małe, ale dadzą sobie radę.

source_text: You suspect any visits in the night?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.You suspect any visits in the night?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.You suspect any visits in the night?"

translation: Podejrzewasz nocne odwiedziny?

source_text: Judy won’t do that.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Judy won’t do that.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Judy won’t do that."

translation: Judy by tego nie zrobiła.

source_text: She’s a nun.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She’s a nun.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.She’s a nun."

translation: Jest zakonnicą.

source_text: She’s also a woman.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.She’s also a woman.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.She’s also a woman."

translation: Ale jest też kobietą.

source_text: Carol…

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Carol…
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Carol…"

translation: Carol…

source_text: I’m going up to change. The couch is all yours.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.I’m going up to change. The couch is all yours.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.I’m going up to change. The couch is all yours."

translation: Idę się przebrać. Kanapa jest do twojej dyspozycji.

source_text: See ya later, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.See ya later, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.See ya later, Carol."

translation: Do zobaczenia, Carol.

source_text: Guess we’re stuck here. That storm isn’t letting up.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Guess we’re stuck here. That storm isn’t letting up.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Guess we’re stuck here. That storm isn’t letting up."

translation: Chyba utknęliśmy. Burza nie odpuszcza.

source_text: Might as well get to bed… It’s going to be an early morning tomorrow.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Might as well get to bed… It’s going to be an early morning tomorrow.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Might as well get to bed… It’s going to be an early morning tomorrow."

translation: Lepiej położyć się spać… Jutro trzeba wcześnie wstać.

source_text: This isn’t the most comfortable couch.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.This isn’t the most comfortable couch.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.This isn’t the most comfortable couch."

translation: Ta kanapa nie jest zbyt wygodna.

source_text: I wonder if Hannah is being nice to Judy…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I wonder if Hannah is being nice to Judy…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I wonder if Hannah is being nice to Judy…"

translation: Ciekawe, czy Hannah jest miła dla Judy…

source_text: I wonder what Heather’s doing right now.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I wonder what Heather’s doing right now.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I wonder what Heather’s doing right now."

translation: Ciekawe, co teraz robi Heather.

source_text: What’s up with Carol? She’s hiding something.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.What’s up with Carol? She’s hiding something.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.What’s up with Carol? She’s hiding something."

translation: Co jest z Carol? Coś przede mną ukrywa.

source_text: Ugh… I can’t sleep.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Ugh… I can’t sleep.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Ugh… I can’t sleep."

translation: Ugh… Nie mogę zasnąć.

source_text: I need a snack.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I need a snack.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I need a snack."

translation: Przydałaby mi się przekąska.

source_text: You better get to church. You’re running late.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.You better get to church. You’re running late.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.You better get to church. You’re running late."

translation: Lepiej idź już do kościoła. Spóźnisz się.

source_text: Did you find Hannah?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Did you find Hannah?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Did you find Hannah?"

translation: Znalazłeś Hannah?

source_text: She went to Heather’s… In her underwear.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.She went to Heather’s… In her underwear.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.She went to Heather’s… In her underwear."

translation: Poszła do Heather… w samej bieliźnie.

source_text: That girl is going to get herself into a lot of trouble.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.That girl is going to get herself into a lot of trouble.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.That girl is going to get herself into a lot of trouble."

translation: Ta dziewczyna narobi sobie kłopotów.

source_text: I don’t need any help with dinner, but thanks for the offer.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.I don’t need any help with dinner, but thanks for the offer.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.I don’t need any help with dinner, but thanks for the offer."

translation: Nie potrzebuję pomocy przy kolacji, ale dziękuję za propozycję.

source_text: Supper will be ready once you get back from the barn.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Supper will be ready once you get back from the barn.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Supper will be ready once you get back from the barn."

translation: Kolacja będzie gotowa, kiedy wrócisz ze stodoły.

source_text: Thanks for helping us with the mess, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Thanks for helping us with the mess, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Thanks for helping us with the mess, 1Hero."

translation: Dzięki za pomoc w sprzątaniu, 1Hero.

source_text: No problem, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.No problem, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.No problem, Carol."

translation: Nie ma sprawy, Carol.

source_text: Any luck finding something?

structure.raw_value: HnBaOp.Any luck finding something?
structure.script_literal: "HnBaOp.Any luck finding something?"

translation: Udało ci się coś znaleźć?

source_text: Yeah, this soot cleaner should do the trick.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yeah, this soot cleaner should do the trick.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yeah, this soot cleaner should do the trick."

translation: Tak, ten środek do czyszczenia sadzy powinien pomóc.

source_text: Looks like 1Hero saved the day again.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe^.Looks like 1Hero saved the day again.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe^.Looks like 1Hero saved the day again."

translation: Wygląda na to, że 1Hero znów uratował sytuację.

source_text: Where would we be without him?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp^.Where would we be without him?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp^.Where would we be without him?"

translation: Co byśmy bez niego zrobiły?

source_text: Sleeping in a stinky house, for one thing!

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx.Sleeping in a stinky house, for one thing!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx.Sleeping in a stinky house, for one thing!"

translation: Na przykład spałybyśmy w śmierdzącym domu!

source_text: Alright, let’s get this done…

structure.raw_value: CaBaOp^.Alright, let’s get this done…
structure.script_literal: "CaBaOp^.Alright, let’s get this done…"

translation: Dobra, zabierajmy się do roboty…

source_text: …before Hannah falls asleep from eating too much at Dick’s.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp^.…before Hannah falls asleep from eating too much at Dick’s.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp^.…before Hannah falls asleep from eating too much at Dick’s."

translation: …zanim Hannah zaśnie po obżarstwie u Dicka.

source_text: I ain’t going to fall asleep. I can handle a big meal.

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.I ain’t going to fall asleep. I can handle a big meal.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.I ain’t going to fall asleep. I can handle a big meal."

translation: Nie zasnę. Dam radę zjeść porządny posiłek.

source_text: Let’s focus on cleaning for now.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Let’s focus on cleaning for now.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Let’s focus on cleaning for now."

translation: Na razie skupmy się na sprzątaniu.

source_text: Just like new!

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Just like new!
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Just like new!"

translation: Jak nowe!

source_text: Hannah.

structure.raw_value: CaAnOp.Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOp.Hannah."

translation: Hannah.

source_text: So much for your reward, whatever that was s’posed to be.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.So much for your reward, whatever that was s’posed to be.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.So much for your reward, whatever that was s’posed to be."

translation: Czyli nici z twojej nagrody, czymkolwiek miała być.

source_text: No worries. I just like helping you ladies out.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.No worries. I just like helping you ladies out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.No worries. I just like helping you ladies out."

translation: Nie szkodzi. Lubię wam pomagać.

source_text: Nonsense. I think you should still get something for your troubles.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Nonsense. I think you should still get something for your troubles.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Nonsense. I think you should still get something for your troubles."

translation: Ależ skąd. I tak należy ci się coś za fatygę.

source_text: How about you head up to my bedroom? I think you’ll like what you’ll find.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.How about you head up to my bedroom? I think you’ll like what you’ll find.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.How about you head up to my bedroom? I think you’ll like what you’ll find."

translation: Może wejdziesz do mojej sypialni? Chyba spodoba ci się to, co tam znajdziesz.

source_text: Your bedroom?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Your bedroom?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Your bedroom?"

translation: Do twojej sypialni?

source_text: Up the stairs. I know you know where it is. Ya little snooper.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Up the stairs. I know you know where it is. Ya little snooper.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Up the stairs. I know you know where it is. Ya little snooper."

translation: Na górę po schodach. Wiem, że znasz drogę, mały podglądaczu.

source_text: I hope my reward isn’t a cucumber.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I hope my reward isn’t a cucumber.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I hope my reward isn’t a cucumber."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nagrodą nie będzie ogórek.

source_text: You’ll just have to go up and see.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.You’ll just have to go up and see.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.You’ll just have to go up and see."

translation: Musisz wejść na górę i sam się przekonać.

source_text: Don’t worry, 1Hero. I talked Heather down from the cliff.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Don’t worry, 1Hero. I talked Heather down from the cliff.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Don’t worry, 1Hero. I talked Heather down from the cliff."

translation: Nie martw się, 1Hero. Uspokoiłam Heather.

source_text: I’d ask you what you said, but maybe I’d rather not know.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I’d ask you what you said, but maybe I’d rather not know.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I’d ask you what you said, but maybe I’d rather not know."

translation: Zapytałbym, co jej powiedziałaś, ale może lepiej nie wiedzieć.

source_text: Having a fun evening, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Having a fun evening, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Having a fun evening, 1Hero?"

translation: Miło spędzasz wieczór, 1Hero?

source_text: Oh, she went home about an hour ago.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Oh, she went home about an hour ago.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Oh, she went home about an hour ago."

translation: Och, wróciła do domu jakieś godzinę temu.

source_text: I heard you had quite the party at Heather’s house.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.I heard you had quite the party at Heather’s house.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.I heard you had quite the party at Heather’s house."

translation: Słyszałam, że u Heather była niezła impreza.

source_text: Oh, thank God. It’s over.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Oh, thank God. It’s over.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Oh, thank God. It’s over."

translation: Och, dzięki Bogu. Już po wszystkim.

source_text: If I told you it was a magic rock, would you believe me?

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.If I told you it was a magic rock, would you believe me?
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.If I told you it was a magic rock, would you believe me?"

translation: Gdybym powiedział, że to przez magiczny kamień, uwierzyłabyś mi?

source_text: What are you talking about? It’s like you were possessed.

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl.What are you talking about? It’s like you were possessed.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl.What are you talking about? It’s like you were possessed."

translation: O czym ty mówisz? Zachowywałeś się, jakbyś był opętany.

source_text: I had a dream last night…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I had a dream last night…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I had a dream last night…"

translation: Miałem wczoraj w nocy sen…

source_text: About this?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.About this?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.About this?"

translation: O tym?

source_text: There’s something really strange going on in the Casula forest.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.There’s something really strange going on in the Casula forest.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.There’s something really strange going on in the Casula forest."

translation: W lesie Casula dzieje się coś naprawdę dziwnego.

source_text: Do you have a fever?

structure.raw_value: HeSaOp.Do you have a fever?
structure.script_literal: "HeSaOp.Do you have a fever?"

translation: Masz gorączkę?

source_text: Let’s get dressed before Carol gets back.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Let’s get dressed before Carol gets back.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Let’s get dressed before Carol gets back."

translation: Ubierzmy się, zanim Carol wróci.

source_text: It’s raining cats and dogs out there!

structure.raw_value: HnShAg.It’s raining cats and dogs out there!
structure.script_literal: "HnShAg.It’s raining cats and dogs out there!"

translation: Ale leje!

source_text: Did Judy stay at the church?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Did Judy stay at the church?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Did Judy stay at the church?"

translation: Judy została w kościele?

source_text: She’s preparing for Mass.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.She’s preparing for Mass.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.She’s preparing for Mass."

translation: Przygotowuje się do mszy.

source_text: Yeah. She’s reading and being boring.

structure.raw_value: HnAnDe.Yeah. She’s reading and being boring.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnDe.Yeah. She’s reading and being boring."

translation: Tak. Czyta i jest nudna.

source_text: You can afford to read a book or two, young lady.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.You can afford to read a book or two, young lady.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.You can afford to read a book or two, young lady."

translation: Tobie też przydałoby się przeczytać jakąś książkę, młoda damo.

source_text: I learn from doing, not reading.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.I learn from doing, not reading.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.I learn from doing, not reading."

translation: Uczę się przez działanie, nie czytanie.

source_text: It’s getting late. Are you ready to go home, Chloe?

structure.raw_value: HeBaDe.It’s getting late. Are you ready to go home, Chloe?
structure.script_literal: "HeBaDe.It’s getting late. Are you ready to go home, Chloe?"

translation: Robi się późno. Jesteś gotowa wracać do domu, Chloe?

source_text: You’re not staying for lunch?

structure.raw_value: HnShOp.You’re not staying for lunch?
structure.script_literal: "HnShOp.You’re not staying for lunch?"

translation: Nie zostaniesz na lunch?

source_text: I just… have a lot to do around the house today.

structure.raw_value: HeBaEx.I just… have a lot to do around the house today.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaEx.I just… have a lot to do around the house today."

translation: Po prostu… mam dziś dużo do zrobienia w domu.

source_text: But I was going to play with Hannah.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.But I was going to play with Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.But I was going to play with Hannah."

translation: Ale miałam się bawić z Hannah.

source_text: You’re not a kid, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: HeAnDe.You’re not a kid, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "HeAnDe.You’re not a kid, Chloe."

translation: Nie jesteś już dzieckiem, Chloe.

source_text: I’m fine. I just need to get going.

structure.raw_value: HeBaDe.I’m fine. I just need to get going.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaDe.I’m fine. I just need to get going."

translation: Wszystko w porządku. Muszę już iść.

source_text: Well, if there’s anything you need help with, let us know.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Well, if there’s anything you need help with, let us know.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Well, if there’s anything you need help with, let us know."

translation: Jeśli będziesz potrzebować pomocy, daj nam znać.

source_text: Don’t stay out too late tonight, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: HeBaEx.Don’t stay out too late tonight, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "HeBaEx.Don’t stay out too late tonight, Chloe."

translation: Nie siedź dziś zbyt długo poza domem, Chloe.

source_text: What the hell happened while we were gone?

structure.raw_value: HnWoOp.What the hell happened while we were gone?
structure.script_literal: "HnWoOp.What the hell happened while we were gone?"

translation: Co się, do cholery, stało, kiedy nas nie było?

source_text: It’s nothing. Don’t worry about it.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.It’s nothing. Don’t worry about it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.It’s nothing. Don’t worry about it."

translation: Nic takiego. Nie martw się.

source_text: Leave the boy alone, girls. He’s busy.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Leave the boy alone, girls. He’s busy.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Leave the boy alone, girls. He’s busy."

translation: Dajcie chłopakowi spokój, dziewczyny. Jest zajęty.

source_text: I should get going too.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I should get going too.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I should get going too."

translation: Ja też powinienem już iść.

source_text: Don’t work on the weekend, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HnSaEx.Don’t work on the weekend, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HnSaEx.Don’t work on the weekend, 1Hero."

translation: Nie pracuj w weekend, 1Hero.

source_text: There’s a lot going on with work. I should get going.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.There’s a lot going on with work. I should get going.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.There’s a lot going on with work. I should get going."

translation: Mam sporo spraw w pracy. Muszę już iść.

source_text: You’re welcome back any time.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.You’re welcome back any time.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.You’re welcome back any time."

translation: Zawsze możesz do nas wpaść.

source_text: Whatever happened here, it’s got Heather rattled.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe^.Whatever happened here, it’s got Heather rattled.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe^.Whatever happened here, it’s got Heather rattled."

translation: Cokolwiek się tu wydarzyło, Heather jest tym wstrząśnięta.

source_text: Come for some lovin’, hunky man?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Come for some lovin’, hunky man?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Come for some lovin’, hunky man?"

translation: Przyszedłeś po trochę czułości, przystojniaku?

source_text: Heh, not today.

structure.raw_value: McFlOpNo4.Heh, not today.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOpNo4.Heh, not today."

translation: Heh, nie dzisiaj.

source_text: Actually, I wanted to ask you about… my dad.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Actually, I wanted to ask you about… my dad.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Actually, I wanted to ask you about… my dad."

translation: Właściwie chciałem zapytać cię o… mojego tatę.

source_text: That’s depressing. Why talk about him?

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.That’s depressing. Why talk about him?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.That’s depressing. Why talk about him?"

translation: Ale ponury temat. Po co o nim rozmawiać?

source_text: I’m trying to get into an old briefcase of his.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’m trying to get into an old briefcase of his.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I’m trying to get into an old briefcase of his."

translation: Próbuję otworzyć jego stary neseser.

source_text: There’s a code. To break it, I require some kind of special info, maybe a name or numbers.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s a code. To break it, I require some kind of special info, maybe a name or numbers.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s a code. To break it, I require some kind of special info, maybe a name or numbers."

translation: Jest zamknięty na szyfr. Żeby go złamać, potrzebuję jakiejś szczególnej informacji, może imienia albo liczb.

source_text: Any idea what might have been special to young Kirk Chesterfield?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Any idea what might have been special to young Kirk Chesterfield?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Any idea what might have been special to young Kirk Chesterfield?"

translation: Masz pomysł, co mogło być ważne dla młodego Kirka Chesterfielda?

source_text: Kirk could be sentimental.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.Kirk could be sentimental.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.Kirk could be sentimental."

translation: Kirk bywał sentymentalny.

source_text: There was a big party he was throwing. He was in rare form then, even for Kirk.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.There was a big party he was throwing. He was in rare form then, even for Kirk.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.There was a big party he was throwing. He was in rare form then, even for Kirk."

translation: Urządził kiedyś wielką imprezę. Nawet jak na Kirka był wtedy w wyjątkowym nastroju.

source_text: Heather gave him a nickname during the party because of it.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Heather gave him a nickname during the party because of it.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Heather gave him a nickname during the party because of it."

translation: Heather nadała mu wtedy przezwisko.

source_text: He immediately loved it, and started referring to himself that way for the rest of the party…

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.He immediately loved it, and started referring to himself that way for the rest of the party…
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.He immediately loved it, and started referring to himself that way for the rest of the party…"

translation: Od razu mu się spodobało i przez resztę imprezy sam tak o sobie mówił…

source_text: Wish I could remember it for you…

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.Wish I could remember it for you…
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.Wish I could remember it for you…"

translation: Szkoda, że nie mogę sobie przypomnieć…

source_text: Are you sure you can’t recall?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Are you sure you can’t recall?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Are you sure you can’t recall?"

translation: Na pewno nic sobie nie przypominasz?

source_text: I know that he loved it so much, he had a special license plate made that said it.

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.I know that he loved it so much, he had a special license plate made that said it.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.I know that he loved it so much, he had a special license plate made that said it."

translation: Wiem, że tak mu się spodobało, że zamówił sobie specjalną tablicę rejestracyjną z tym napisem.

source_text: Maybe if you could find that, you’d have what you need.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Maybe if you could find that, you’d have what you need.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Maybe if you could find that, you’d have what you need."

translation: Może jeśli ją znajdziesz, będziesz mieć potrzebną informację.

source_text: A license plate…

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.A license plate…
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.A license plate…"

translation: Tablica rejestracyjna…

source_text: Alright, I’ll see what I can find.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Alright, I’ll see what I can find.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Alright, I’ll see what I can find."

translation: Dobrze, zobaczę, co uda mi się znaleźć.

source_text: No problem, studmuffin. Don’t forget to come back and show me some sugar later.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.No problem, studmuffin. Don’t forget to come back and show me some sugar later.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.No problem, studmuffin. Don’t forget to come back and show me some sugar later."

translation: Nie ma sprawy, przystojniaku. Wpadnij później i okaż mi trochę czułości.

source_text: You can bet on it.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.You can bet on it.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.You can bet on it."

translation: Możesz na to liczyć.
